result.summary: Page renders cleanly overall but has a filter-state mismatch with Pizza selected while showing poke, burger and ramen results, plus expected carousel clipping and bottom card cutoff.

issues.description: Pizza category pill is selected/active but the restaurant lists still show non-pizza venues: Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria Piccolo, Tokumaru Ramen Bar
issues.suggestion: Ensure selecting a category filter actually filters the lists, or if filters only affect a different view, do not show it as active on this home view

issues.description: Horizontal scroll rows are clipped at the right edge: the far-right category pill is half-visible and the third card name reads 'Trattoria Piccol' with text and image cut off
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding and snap spacing to horizontal carousels so cards and pills are not cut mid-element

issues.description: Second card under Popular right now showing pizza with -20% badge is cut off by bottom tab bar with no restaurant name, delivery time or rating visible
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding above the tab bar and ensure cards render full image plus metadata without being obscured
